notes: The owner's words: *"What you built doesn't appear to match what we had in the data/macro categories, which also doesn't match what we have for cohorts predicates. We appear to be missing things and are not being consistent."* A correction to 5.5.0. He was right about the layout, and the cause was one inherited class. The merged dialog was built on the retired indicator library's element, which carried both .menu.big and .menu.series-modal. The two selectors have equal specificity; .menu.big's max-width:700px is declared first and nothing here overrode it. So width:min(920px,94vw) clamped to 7
